test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Rani said to her boss, “I am going to visit Kashmir and Ladakh next month.”

options.text: Rani informed her boss that she was going to visit Kashmir and Ladakh the following month.
Rani told her boss that I am going to visit Kashmir and Ladakh next month.
Rani informs her boss that she is going to visit Kashmir and Ladakh the next month.
Rani asked her boss that she wanted to visit Kashmir and Ladakh the following month.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**
